reason: mean |SHAP| of each component's model features (LinearRegression), scaled to 80%; yield volatility fixed at 20%

components.rain_variability: Rainfall variability (inter-annual CV of seasonal rain)
components.drought_frequency: Drought frequency (share of seasons with SPI-3 < -1)
components.heat_stress: Heat stress (mean days with Tmax > 35 degC per season)
components.yield_volatility: Yield volatility (std. dev. of detrended yield anomaly, % = CV around trend)

category_rule: quartiles of the district x crop index
district_category_rule: quartiles of the district (area-weighted all-crop) index
